source_sha256_basis: Provided by the parent; not independently rechecked during persistence.
source_document_handling: Private blueprint; source_sha256 and section references identify it.
status_meaning: Partial implementations and concrete gaps were identified by static inspection. Customer-ready behavior has not been established. File existence and test existence do not establish completion.
path_convention: Implementation and source-copy paths are relative to repository_root unless absolute.

scope_and_evidence_limits.method: Bounded static inspection of the assigned blueprint sections and selected existing implementation paths.
limitations: No capability is considered complete from implementation paths or test files alone.
Missing workflow evidence is distinguished from observed limitations in inspected code.
No external credential or provider-access dependency was established as the cause of these implementation gaps.
The parent owns global contracts, shared foundation decisions, credentials, commits, pushes, deployment and goal controls.
Persistence of this audit changes only docs/traceability/capability-audit-11-20.json; no implementation or navigation changes are included.

first_foundation_dependency.requirement: Connect the assigned domains to the existing typed service/tool execution path, carrying server-created actor context, object permissions, validated proposals, source provenance, AgentRun linkage and idempotent domain events.

observed_evidence.finding: The closed registry registers calendar, tasks, groceries, reminders, family and notifications. The assigned specialist tool sets are absent; calendar has only partial coverage of its packet.

Existing service scope, family-scoped persistence, structured errors and activity example.

first_foundation_dependency.first_safe_vertical_slice: Parent-led, provider-free extension of calendar conflict analysis using existing calendar and ride records: resolve the actor on the server, permission-filter the inputs, return a typed proposal with evidence and unknown travel assumptions, and expose it through the existing registry. Establish denied-access and structured-result evidence in an isolated environment before adding domain writes or external actions.

capabilities.required_workflow: Goal and constraints to options, chosen trip, itinerary, reservations, preparation, travel-day operation, disruption handling and archive.

existing_implementation.evidence: The builder persists activities, itinerary items, budgets and packing; recommendations consume trip context and rule helpers.
The trip AI page gates access and renders TripConcierge for a vacation ID.

gaps.finding: The builder uses JSON.parse on model text without a runtime output schema; concierge calls the provider with no tools.
Source-preserving confirmation import, timestamped provider availability and disruption replanning were not established.
The travel tool set is absent from the inspected central registry.

capabilities.first_safe_vertical_slice: Implement travel.import from a non-production confirmation fixture to reviewed, source-linked reservation and itinerary records, with runtime schemas and idempotency. Add a proposal-only travel.replan path using recorded facts; bookings remain outside this slice.

test_and_journey_evidence.next_journey: Import a confirmation fixture, correct a material field, retain the original source, replay without duplicates, and propose a disruption adjustment without booking.

capabilities.required_workflow: Event ingestion and member resolution to conflicts, travel calculation, assignment validation, preparation and change propagation.

existing_implementation.evidence: The route renders the existing CalendarModule.
Typed calendar CRUD, conflict, free-slot and busy-evening tools delegate to services.
Conflict input contains event times and assignee; free-slot analysis also reads school and sports events.
Driver conflict detection compares the same driver, date and exact pickup time.
Provider capability definitions describe supported calendar mechanisms; live integration behavior was not tested.

gaps.finding: Different pickup times can still be physically incompatible; exact pickup-time matching does not establish travel feasibility.
The inspected calendar conflict service does not include transport or preparation dependencies in its conflict inputs.
The packet's transport/departure/resolution tools and downstream assignment-change propagation were not established.

capabilities.first_safe_vertical_slice: Extend the existing calendar service and registry with permission-filtered event/ride dependency analysis. Return an evidence-backed departure and driver proposal using explicit or recorded travel buffers; then validate resolution and change propagation in an isolated environment without sending notifications.

test_and_journey_evidence.next_journey: Detect two differently timed pickups that cannot both be driven, explain the travel/preparation conflict, propose another owner and verify dependent changes under isolated fixtures.

capabilities.required_workflow: Parenting issue to scoped household context, operational plan, optional routine/tasks and user-selected follow-up.

existing_implementation.evidence: The parent route redirects to Family Operations.
The dashboard gathers family signals and renders operational counts and next-action links.
Saved routine templates materialize concrete calendar events.

gaps.finding: No traced fix-our-morning workflow combines school departure, responsibilities, household preferences and selected follow-up.
Permissioned caregiver handoffs and durable parenting rules/preferences were not established in the inspected path.
The parent routine, handoff and responsibility tools are absent from the inspected central registry.

capabilities.first_safe_vertical_slice: Add parent.routine to produce a reviewable, owner-assigned morning plan from existing school/calendar constraints. Persist approved routine steps, household preferences and handoff visibility through the shared service path in an isolated environment; do not send caregiver messages.

test_and_journey_evidence.next_journey: Request a less chaotic morning, edit the proposed responsibilities, persist and reload the routine, and verify a restricted caregiver cannot read private handoff notes.

capabilities.required_workflow: Participants and available time to available catalog, guardian restrictions, ranking, explained picks and saved outcome.

existing_implementation.evidence: The route gates access and renders WatchlistModule.
Audience, available minutes and service selectors feed the deterministic picker; the module persists votes and watch sessions.
The picker filters and ranks existing household titles using known audience ages, runtime, service and votes.

gaps.finding: Unknown audience ages are ignored; when no age is known, the picker applies no age filter.
Availability relies on manually entered service metadata rather than a dated catalog availability result.
Guardian-controlled server restrictions and the complete entertainment tool workflow were not established.

capabilities.first_safe_vertical_slice: Enforce guardian restrictions in a server service, clarify unknown ages and return typed entertainment.recommend results. Validate the normalized catalog adapter with recorded fixtures, including unknown/stale availability; perform no live provider actions.

test_and_journey_evidence.next_journey: Choose an audience including a child with unknown age, enforce guardian restrictions, reject stale availability claims and persist feedback on an allowed pick.

capabilities.capability: Home Digital Twin and Predictive Maintenance
capabilities.required_workflow: Asset capture, identification and confirmation to source documents, maintenance schedule, reminders, service history and future interval updates.

existing_implementation.evidence: The module reads assets/tasks/documents and supports asset and maintenance-task operations.
Actions persist service records and schedule recommended maintenance from deterministic cadences.
Helpers define category-based maintenance cadences and asset life/warranty calculations.
The forecast endpoint creates narrative advice from supplied asset data.

gaps.finding: No traced photo/manual to confirmed asset fields to source-backed maintenance to updated future interval workflow was established.
The inspected forecast is narrative output from supplied assets, without manufacturer-source evidence or validated structured maintenance proposals.
The home specialist tool set is absent from the inspected central registry.

capabilities.first_safe_vertical_slice: Implement home.capture/identify with a non-production appliance-label/manual fixture, editable field confirmation and provenance. Link the confirmed asset to a maintenance plan and verify service completion updates its lifecycle without contacting contractors.

test_and_journey_evidence.next_journey: Capture an appliance, correct its model, retain the supporting source, accept a maintenance plan and record service with an updated future interval.

capabilities.required_workflow: Date detection to lead-time signal, owner, proposed plan, optional approved commerce/reservation and remembered outcome.

existing_implementation.evidence: The authenticated route renders RelationshipModule.
The module persists gift statuses and supports manual, wishlist and AI gift ideas alongside relationship dates/preferences.
Digest inputs include upcoming dates, partner preferences, budget and wishlist.

gaps.finding: The AI digest input lacks past gift outcomes, preventing grounded repeat avoidance within this path.
Shared occasion ownership, preparation checklists, per-occasion budget and remembered outcome orchestration were not established.
The occasion specialist tool set is absent from the inspected central registry.

capabilities.first_safe_vertical_slice: Link an occasion to its recipient, owner, budget, checklist and existing gift outcomes. Add occasion.plan/owner/outcome and a lead-time signal using isolated records; exclude purchases, reservations and messages.

test_and_journey_evidence.next_journey: Plan a birthday using last year's recorded gift, assign one owner, avoid duplicate selection and retain this year's outcome for future recall.

capabilities.required_workflow: Care circle, invitation/consent and visibility to schedules/tasks, responsibility assignment, handoff and audited access.

existing_implementation.evidence: The feature-gated route renders CareModule.
Current family members are selectable recipients; care_log stores check-ins, notes, wellbeing and appointment-type entries.

gaps.finding: The care log does not establish consent-based, multi-household care circles or granular note sharing.
Who is taking Dad lacks a traced task/transport assignment and authorized handoff workflow.
The care specialist tool set is absent from the inspected central registry.

capabilities.first_safe_vertical_slice: Establish care-circle consent and object permissions using isolated household fixtures, then add care.assign/handoff/share with access auditing and permission-filtered summaries. No live invitations, notifications or care-provider actions are included.

test_and_journey_evidence.next_journey: Authorize a caregiver for one appointment, assign transport, generate an allowed handoff and demonstrate that private notes and revoked access are excluded.

capabilities.required_workflow: Ingestion and file security checks to OCR/parser, classification, confidence-validated facts, summary, linked action proposals and required confirmation.

existing_implementation.evidence: Local upload stores a file and inserts document metadata, including an optional expiry date.
Download uses the existing signed-document URL helper.
Magic Import parses pasted text into proposed actions; the confirmation phase evaluates trust before execution.

gaps.finding: The inspected upload path ends after file/metadata persistence; it does not enqueue classification/extraction or establish source-located factual records.
Immutable version comparison, cited document questions and reviewed document-obligation execution were not established.
The document specialist tool set is absent from the inspected central registry.

capabilities.first_safe_vertical_slice: Connect an immutable source/version fixture to bounded extraction, reviewable fields and approved linked task/event proposals through document tools. Use recorded parser/provider fixtures in an isolated environment; do not submit forms or contact external services.

test_and_journey_evidence.next_journey: Upload a bill fixture, inspect the source location of amount/date, correct a field, approve one obligation and replay without duplicate tasks.

capabilities.required_workflow: Capture and normalized quantities/expiry to meal consumption, confirmed decrement, expiry signals and recipe suggestions.

existing_implementation.evidence: The module reads pantry inventory, adjusts quantities and adds low-stock items to groceries.
Helpers derive expiry labels and expiring-item order from expires_at.
Fridge Chef provides photo-based recipe suggestions and paths that create meals, meal plans and grocery items.
Separate pure helpers classify leftover urgency and produce use-first nudges.

gaps.finding: Photo-to-recipe does not establish photo-to-persisted inventory or a meal-driven consumption ledger.
The inspected expiry-label helper receives a date without distinguishing estimated from source-provided expiry.
The pantry specialist tool set is absent from the inspected central registry.

capabilities.first_safe_vertical_slice: Add pantry.capture with recorded receipt/photo extraction fixtures, editable quantities and expiry provenance, then idempotent pantry.consume linked to a meal and batch. Reuse expiring-item and recipe helpers without making food-safety guarantees or live provider calls.

test_and_journey_evidence.next_journey: Review captured items, correct a quantity and estimated expiry, consume a meal once despite replay, and obtain a source-aware use-first suggestion.

capabilities.required_workflow: Recurring-charge candidate to confirmation, plan/renewal enrichment, price monitoring, review and truthful cancellation guidance or supported approved action.

existing_implementation.evidence: The module persists manually tracked subscriptions, usage/status and renewal dates.
Helpers calculate annual/monthly costs and stale-subscription totals.
The UI labels stale rows unused and missing last_used as never used.

gaps.finding: Missing last_used is treated as stale and displayed as unused/never used instead of unknown usage.
Recurring-charge confirmation, member dependencies, price-history review and truthful cancellation guidance were not established in the inspected workflow.
The subscription specialist tool set is absent from the inspected central registry.

capabilities.first_safe_vertical_slice: Distinguish unknown usage and ask the household before classifying waste. Add subscription.detect/confirm/review over isolated normalized-charge fixtures, member dependencies and price history; cancellation_help remains guidance without account changes or payment calls.

test_and_journey_evidence.next_journey: Confirm an uncertain recurring charge, answer an unknown-usage question, identify a recorded price increase and preserve another member's dependency when reviewing cancellation.
